status_meanings.verified_primary: Official/academic primary source found and claim broadly supported.
status_meanings.verified_industry: Reputable industry source found; use for trend/practice framing, not immutable fact.
status_meanings.partially_verified: A related source was verified, but some specific claims need tighter sourcing.
status_meanings.verified_secondary: Secondary source found; prefer official vendor/paper if available.
status_meanings.needs_exact_url: Source family is plausible but exact URL/citation still needs pinning.
status_meanings.needs_stronger_source: Claim is plausible but not sufficiently backed by the current source set.
status_meanings.not_found_high_risk: Could not locate the named source; do not cite as fact until found.
status_meanings.verified_but_year_corrected: Source exists but the archive/year label should be corrected.
status_meanings.verified_primary_with_date_correction: Source exists but release/report date differs from notes.
status_meanings.verified_primary_with_nuance: Source exists but claim needs exact wording/qualification.
